case_title: Polamuri Chandra Sekhararao @ Chinna @ Babji v. State of A.P.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s. 302 IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, who was not in good terms with his wife and her family, was the uncle of the deceased, who was the son of his elder sister. The deceased had developed a close relationship with the accused's daughter, which angered the accused. The deceased visited the accused's house, where he was questioned about his intentions. The accused became enraged and stabbed the deceased multiple times with a knife. The deceased's body was found in the accused's compound. The accused and his daughters went to the police station and handed over the knife. The prosecution relied on the presence of the deceased's body, the knife found at the scene, and the testimony of the accused's daughters, despite their hostile demeanor. The trial court considered the circumstantial evidence, including the forensic science laboratory report confirming human blood on the knife, and convicted the accused of murder.
